reasoning.text: The ISO render reads cleanly and quickly as an FPGA NTT card: eight blue interleaved BRAM banks line the −X edge, the copper DSP-multiplier column and the symmetric add/sub pairs sit in an open framed array, the exploded radix-4 BU and ten-fin heatsink lift cleanly off the die, and FRONT/SIDE show no parts sunk below or floating above the ground line. Form is mature; the binding deficit remains reproduction-faithfulness, not silhouette. The one residual geometry defect the previous pass flagged is real: bu_add_0 (z=−4.09, outer face −4.30) and bu_sub_7 (z=+4.09, outer face +4.30) overhang the array floor's z=±4.2 edge by ~0.1 m — fixed this pass by widening the open frame to contain them rather than nudging the operators into interpenetration. The deep faithfulness gaps (the paper's exact conflict-free bank/offset functions, crossbar permutation σ_s, twiddle-ROM addressing, DIT/DIF convention, radix-4 fusion mapping and per-stage cycle counts) are honestly flagged in the specs as reproduction candidates and require the CFNTT source PDF, which is not available in this non-interactive pass.
gaps: Make reproducible — record the control: transcribe the paper's ACTUAL conflict-free bank-index b(i) and offset o(i) (CFNTT Sec. III headline result); the candidate b(i)=(i+(i>>3)) mod 8 provably collides for strides 2^6..2^9 (parts crossbar_network, addr_gen_unit). Requires the source PDF — not closeable from the render.

Make reproducible — record the control: the crossbar per-stage permutation sigma_s mapping logical operand indices to physical bank/lane ports must come from the source, not the reproduction-candidate rotation map (part crossbar_network).
Make reproducible — record the operation: twiddle-ROM address function f(stage s, block index) and the negacyclic low/high-half storage layout need source confirmation (part twiddle_rom).
Make reproducible — record the operation: confirm DIT vs DIF and the global butterfly/stage ordering against the source (currently a reproduction choice in schedule_controller).

Make reproducible — record the operation: radix-4 fusion mapping — which two radix-2 stages fuse per radix-4 BU and the j-rotator sign convention — needs source confirmation (parts config_radix_selector, r4_fuse_*).
Make reproducible — record the timing: FSM per-stage cycle counts of the twiddle-stationary schedule are reconstructed, not transcribed (part schedule_controller).
Make reproducible — record the param: primitive-root generator g=11 and psi=1945 plus the full twiddle table are reproduction-pinned; confirm against source (part twiddle_rom).
Make reproducible — record the operation: modular adder/subtractor internal reduction policy (conditional +/-q correction count) needs source confirmation (part mod_red_subshift).
Match the source's architecture: the twiddle-stationary 'rearranged loop structure' is still a generic Cooley-Tukey stage/block loop in spec; the true reuse schedule must come from the source.

fields.before: Thin open floor of the butterfly-array frame; together with the two longitudinal rails and the cross-brace it forms an open chassis spanning all eight parallel lanes, exposing every DSP multiplier and symmetric add/sub operator from above (X-ray cutaway).
fields.after: Thin open floor of the butterfly-array frame; together with the two longitudinal rails and the cross-brace it forms an open chassis spanning all eight parallel lanes, exposing every DSP multiplier and symmetric add/sub operator from above (X-ray cutaway). Floor depth 8.8 m fully contains the outermost add/sub operators (z=±4.30) within its ±4.4 edge.
